items.title: The scheme theoretic image is functorial along a commutative diagram of morphisms

items.difficulty_reason: The statement is that in a commutative square of schemes the scheme theoretic images Z_i of the horizontal maps are connected by an induced morphism Z_1 to Z_2, giving the displayed commutative diagram (statement lines 948-967). The proof is three lines and its content is a universal-property argument: the scheme theoretic inverse image of Z_2 in Y_1 is a closed subscheme through which f_1 factors, so the minimality of the scheme theoretic image Z_1 puts Z_1 inside that pullback, which is exactly the induced morphism (proof lines 969-973). It is H2: the argument is complete and short, and the only inputs are the definition of the scheme theoretic image and of the scheme theoretic inverse image; the two xymatrix displays are the author's own and were not redrawn.
